Clara (PM): Quick sync: multiple customers report console previews for saved per-route queries show a different model than actual runtime. Can previews default to the saved behavior and explain risk?

Dev (Backend): We only persist model_hint. Two pragmatic options: store deterministic_model_id when user pins an exact model version, or add a server preview endpoint that calls routing-service in simulate mode.

Sofia (Console): UX: default should be 'Preview as saved'. Add a tiny toggle to switch to 'Live route'. Show a compact pill for model provenance: Pinned / Route-default / Fallback, and an "accuracy" tag if it's approximate.

Ben (Routing): routing-service already has a simulate tool. We can expose routing.preview that returns deterministic_model_id, policy_version, and a fallback_risk (low/med/high). It won't allocate capacity.

Aria (Telemetry): Mark preview calls with preview=true and preview_mode. Exclude previews from billing/aggregate metrics. Add preview_sample_id to join preview events to traces. Also set rate-limit alerts if previews spike.

ci-bot: routing.preview service scheduled canary deploy 2026-04-10T03:00Z.

Dev (Backend): API sketch: POST /savedqueries/{id}/preview body: {mode: "saved"|"live"|"simulate"} resp (strings): {model_used, deterministic_model_id, fallback_bucket, policy_version, est_tokens, p95_ms, est_cost_cents, preview_sample_id}. We'll enforce per-user rate-limits and cache TTL 45s.

Sofia (Console): Microcopy: "Estimates computed using saved config. Actual routing may differ under load or after policy changes (policy vX.Y used for this preview)." UI: show small info icon linking to explanation page.

Clara (PM): Actions: Dev spec + auth; Ben expose policy_version & fallback bucket; Sofia mock toggle + copy; Aria add telemetry contract + dashboards to detect preview leakage. I'll draft RFC after prototypes land. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
